explanation: Go, called weiqi in China, appears in writings from the 4th century BC. Chess grew from chaturanga, played in India about a thousand years later.

claims.text: Go (weiqi) is mentioned in Chinese writings from the 4th century BC.
Chess descends from chaturanga, which was played in India by about the 6th century AD.
Go is called weiqi in Chinese.
